aim.note: Owner decision 2026-11-11: a regular soldier, prone, rested and calm, firing aimed single shots, hits a man-sized standing target about 50 % of the time at 300 m; training level scales it (conscript worse, veteran better). The base error (1.13 mrad at skill 0.5) is set so the firing range lab shows that. Posture, fatigue, heart-rate, suppression, rapid-fire and burst factors are game values to be tuned in the lab and in M4. Aiming time (M2 completion): the first shots at a new target are up to 60 % worse, settling within a few seconds. Bracing: kneeling or standing with a wall, fence, hedge or tree within about 2-3 m reduces the error by 20 %. Both are game values. Target movement is not in the error yet: fire is at a point until targets exist (M3/M4).

fire.note: Owner decision 2026-11-11: rate of fire depends on range (aimed single shots every 2-3 s beyond 100 m, about one shot a second closer, short bursts inside 30 m). A fire order lasts until cease fire, but the unit manages its ammunition: after 30 s without incoming fire near it, it slows to one aimed shot per man every 10 s, and after another 60 s it ceases fire and reports; incoming fire restores the full rate; each man stops when only the magazine in his weapon is left. Men swap a partly used magazine for a fuller one after 5 s without firing. From M3 'expects an enemy' will use what the men see, not only incoming fire.

grenades.note: Owner decision 2026-11-11: a regular soldier in full kit throws about 30 m standing, 20 m crouching, 10-12 m prone, landing within a few metres of the aim point; training level scales range error. Launcher error and preparation times are game values. Owner requests 2026-11-11: the thrower chooses a flatter or higher throw when the lob would hit a ceiling or wall; several grenades per order are thrown 0.6 s apart; a man within 10 m of a landing grenade drops flat, within 3 m he runs from it first. Angles, power margin, carry and delays are game values. Owner decision 2026-11-11 (after M2.4b): prone throw 15 m and safety distance 8 m, so that prone men can throw.
